name: Benchmark Email
description_en:
Benchmark Email is a managed service for preparing email campaigns, organizing contacts and tracking sends. Its current editor combines reusable blocks, a brand kit, imported HTML and personalization. An operator selects a list or filtered contacts, reviews the message, and schedules or sends it.

The official site has separate entry points for Benchmark NEW and Benchmark Classic. Its marketing-automation page promotes BenchmarkONE, another product; that page is not proof that all BenchmarkONE automation belongs to the new email account. This profile focuses on the documented next-generation email workflow and preserves that version boundary.
description_zh:
Benchmark Email 是用于制作邮件活动、整理联系人和跟踪发送的托管服务。当前编辑器结合可复用区块、品牌素材、HTML 导入及个性化内容。运营者选择名单或筛选联系人，检查邮件后排程或发送。

官网为 Benchmark NEW 和 Benchmark Classic 分别提供入口。营销自动化页介绍的是另一个产品 BenchmarkONE，不能据此把其所有自动化能力归入新版邮件账户。本文围绕文档中的新一代邮件流程展开，并保留版本边界。

sections.title_en: Check which Benchmark account the instructions describe
sections.title_zh: 先确认指南适用哪个 Benchmark 账户
sections.en:
The site links separately to the new platform and Classic. The migration guide explains that the new platform centralizes contacts and uses lists built from criteria, rather than treating Classic lists as an identical model. The marketing-automation page specifically sends readers to BenchmarkONE.

A buyer evaluating automated lead scoring should therefore ask which product and contract supplies it. Do not migrate by matching feature labels alone. This profile does not establish parity between Classic automation, BenchmarkONE and the new email platform.
sections.zh:
官网分别链接新版与 Classic。迁移指南说明新版将联系人集中管理，名单按条件构建，不能直接套用 Classic 的名单模型。营销自动化页面还明确把读者引向 BenchmarkONE。

如果要评估自动线索评分，应确认提供该能力的具体产品和合同。迁移不能只对照功能名称；本文未确认 Classic 自动化、BenchmarkONE 和新版邮件平台之间具备功能对等性。

sections.title_en: Import contacts as a maintained audience
sections.en:
The setup guide specifies CSV imports with field labels in the first row, a 100 MB file limit and an email address for each imported contact. Contacts are identified by email and counted once. Tags and custom fields then support organization and personalized messages.

For an illustrative event newsletter, map email, first name and event-interest fields, apply an import tag, then inspect a few records before creating the invitation list. Preserve unsubscribes and permission evidence when moving data; a successful upload alone does not show that the audience is safe to mail.
sections.zh:
入门指南要求 CSV 文件首行有字段名、文件不超过 100 MB，且每条导入联系人包含邮箱。联系人按邮箱识别并只计一次，之后可用标签和自定义字段整理和个性化。

例如活动简报，可映射邮箱、名字和活动兴趣字段，添加导入标签，再抽查记录后建立邀请名单。迁移数据时应保留退订和接收许可依据；上传成功本身不能证明受众适合发信。

sections.title_en: A reusable design still needs recipient-level checks
sections.title_zh: 复用设计仍需逐收件人检查
sections.en:
The current editor accepts a block-based design or existing HTML. The send guide supports personalized subjects and fallback text for missing contact data. For the event example, a first-name greeting needs a sensible fallback and the invitation button needs the actual registration destination.

Previewing desktop and mobile layouts helps inspect the draft, but it does not establish rendering in every real inbox. Test the final content, sender and reply destination with representative addresses before selecting the whole event audience. No email was sent during this research.
sections.zh:
当前编辑器接受区块设计或已有 HTML；发送指南支持个性化主题，以及联系人字段缺失时的后备文字。例如活动邀请中的名字问候应有合理后备内容，报名按钮应指向真实报名页面。

桌面和手机预览有助检查草稿，但不能证明在所有真实邮箱中都正确显示。选择整个活动受众前，应使用代表性地址检查最终内容、发件人和回复目标。本文没有实际发信。

sections.title_en: Prepare DNS access and wait for verification
sections.title_zh: 准备 DNS 权限并等待验证
sections.en:
The current verification guide says Benchmark creates a sending subdomain and provides DNS records according to the provider. It checks propagation until the subdomain is ready. The guide allows minutes through 48 hours and directs users to support after that interval. Repeated DNS edits can restart propagation.

An older setup paragraph says NS records are mandatory, while the current status guide and migration comparison describe one record or multiple records. Use the account’s actual provider-specific instructions rather than assuming that older paragraph describes every supported setup.
sections.zh:
当前验证指南说明 Benchmark 创建发送子域名，并按服务商提供 DNS 记录，检测传播后才进入可发送状态。指南给出的等待范围为几分钟到 48 小时，超过后联系支持；反复修改 DNS 可能重新开始传播。

较早的入门段落称必须使用 NS 记录，但当前状态指南和迁移对比都描述单记录或多记录方式。应以账户实际提供的服务商专项指引为准，不能把旧段落当作所有环境的统一要求。

sections.title_en: Sending is not a reversible preview
sections.title_zh: 发送不能当作可撤销预览
sections.en:
The send guide requires a verified domain. It says duplicate recipients selected across multiple lists receive one copy. A test can target up to five addresses at a time; test links expire after 24 hours. Scheduling follows the browser’s timezone.

Confirm the timezone when planning an international event reminder. A scheduled message can be rescheduled or canceled, but the guide says a message already sent cannot be stopped from delivery. Review the recipient count before Send Now; a content correction afterward needs a new communication decision.
sections.zh:
发送指南要求已验证域名，并说明多名单重复收件人只收到一封。一次测试最多选择五个地址，测试链接 24 小时后失效；排程采用浏览器时区。

安排跨国活动提醒时应核对时区。已排程邮件可改时间或取消，但指南明确表示已发送邮件无法停止投递。点击 Send Now 前应检查收件人数，事后修正文案需要另行决定如何再次沟通。

sections.title_en: Contact capacity and sends are separate limits
sections.title_zh: 联系人容量与发送量分别受限
sections.en:
The current English pricing matrix lists Free with 500 contacts, 2,500 monthly sends, one user and one domain. Pro spans 1,000–100,000 contacts, monthly sends of 10 times the contact limit, one included user and additional users at $15 per month each. The rendered starting card shows $16 per month, but region, contact tier and billing controls affect a quote.

For example, 500 contacts each receiving four newsletters would consume 2,000 sends before any extra messages. This hypothetical arithmetic does not include resends. The German pricing page still shows a different Classic-style allowance; use the current English new-platform matrix for this profile, and confirm the actual account offer.
sections.zh:
当前英文套餐表列出 Free：500 位联系人、每月 2,500 次发送、一个用户和一个域名。Pro 覆盖 1,000–100,000 位联系人，月发送额度为联系人上限的 10 倍，含一个用户，额外用户每人每月 $15。页面起价卡片显示每月 $16，但地区、联系人档位和账单选项会影响报价。

假设 500 位联系人每人收到四封简报，额外邮件之前已消耗 2,000 次发送；这个算例不含重发。德文价格页仍有不同的 Classic 式额度；本档案采用当前英文新版套餐表，并建议核对实际账户报价。

sections.title_en: Assess an email operation, not a promised result
sections.title_zh: 评估邮件运营条件，而非承诺收益
sections.en:
Benchmark’s policy requires specific permission, retention of evidence and production of that evidence within 72 hours of a request. The contact tools describe bounce handling and suppression. These are operating conditions and functions, not evidence of a guaranteed inbox rate.

The new platform is worth evaluating for a newsletter editor who wants contact selection, reusable designs and explicit send review. A team requiring complex journey automation or narrowly restricted collaborator roles should confirm those requirements in the intended product before migrating. Self-hosting rights and source licensing were not established.
sections.zh:
Benchmark 政策要求明确接收许可、保留相关依据，并在被要求后 72 小时内提供。联系人功能说明包括退信和排除名单处理。这些属于运营条件和能力，不能证明保证收件箱到达率。

需要联系人筛选、复用设计和明确发送检查的简报编辑者，可评估新版平台。需要复杂沟通路径自动化或细分协作者权限的团队，应在目标产品中确认后再迁移。本次未确认自托管权利和源码许可。

seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Official Help Scout documentation is linked from the vendor site but crosses registrable domains; current catalog validator rejects it. Preserve actual URLs for coordinator compatibility review.
research_gaps.zh: 官网链接的官方 Help Scout 文档跨注册域名，当前目录校验器会拒绝；保留真实 URL 供协调窗口处理兼容性。

research_gaps.en: No actual migration, DNS change, inbox delivery, API call, unsubscribe or resend was tested. UI language coverage, regional offers, license and checkout totals remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际测试迁移、DNS 修改、收件箱投递、API、退订或重发；界面语言覆盖、地区报价、许可及结算总额仍未核实。
